notes: Fixed: your saved database connections and your Azure DevOps token are no longer lost when you replace the app by hand. They were stored INSIDE the app folder — the one you delete and re-extract — so anyone following "extract into a fresh folder and delete the old one" lost them silently. They now live in %LOCALAPPDATA%PeoplesHR Bug Fixer, which no update can touch. Your existing settings are moved there automatically the first time you open this version; nothing is deleted.
New theme: Yukther — Light, in Visual Studio's classic light palette. Settings → Speed & model → Theme.

Fixed: dropdown values were invisible in the light theme — the open list was painted near-black while the text was near-black too. Every theme now paints its own list, and a test checks the contrast of all of them.

Fixed: the app filed faults against itself that were not faults — clicking Update when you were already up to date, and reporting a long-dead update failure from a version you had moved past. It also counted one finished fix several times.
From 2.10.0, if you missed it: a Plan / Auto switch on the run header. Auto is the default and lets the agent write from the start; the plan gate still waits for you.
